At first glance, Josh Hart tweeting "Argentina = Knicks" makes absolutely zero sense. Like, Josh, what are we even talking about here? 😅 But the more you look into it, the more it actually hits perfectly. Think about it: this Argentina squad has officially become the absolute kings of the comeback. They got pushed into extra time against Cabo Verde, blew the lead twice, and had to grind out a chaotic, ugly own-goal in the 111th minute just to survive. They were down 2-0 to Egypt and somehow pulled a 3-2 win out of thin air. And just when you thought they were done against England, down 1-0 in the second half, they strike twice in the final minutes to steal a spot in the FIFA World Cup final. If that isn't the exact same refuse to die energy we just saw from the New York Knicks during their championship run, I don't know what is. You’ve got Leo Messi playing the role of Jalen Brunson: the genius mastermind who just calmly handles the pressure, surrounded by a bunch of absolute dogs who will slide-tackle or dive for a loose ball like their lives depend on it. They don’t play easy, comfortable games. They make you sweat. They make you scream at your TV. ...and then they somehow find a way to win anyway. Josh Hart isn't crazy. He felt that same energy just a month ago.
